secrets.name: Trench woodfall
secrets.text: Waterlogged wood rests on the trench floor. Sunken plant material can support scavengers and microbes far from sunlight.

secrets.name: Sediment slump
secrets.text: A low scarp marks a small displacement of soft sediment. Fine material has settled against its foot.

secrets.name: Microbial patch
secrets.text: A pale patch in the mud suggests organic matter buried just beneath the sediment surface.
